crossRefs.note: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
“You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
“Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You…
Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land; for everyone who steals shall…
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…
and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath: for all these are things…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price…
While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have…
Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

parallels.note: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

translations.web: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
translations.bsb: And again he denied it with an oath: “I do not know the man!”
translations.kjv: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
translations.asv: And again he denied with an oath, I know not the man.
